method: Author self-score from bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg: orthographic EEVEE renders (AgX, the fixed shared light rig, not tuned to the score) of the low-poly model at the concept sheet's front, side and back angles, framed at the sheet's own scale (2.1 m over 806 sheet pixels), judged side by side against the sheet crops, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine (three.js 0.186.1, headless Chromium on ANGLE Metal, Apple M4, with the runtime D11 glow look; glow-close is the seat camera narrowed to the upper body). This pass followed the independent review (77/100) and its top fixes: the drum pauldrons are replaced by one tall shoulder plate per side (front: x 0.47 to 0.72, z 1.18 to 1.82, a sloped top and rounded outer corner; side: a rim ring, a mid ring and a bezel round a dark glass lens; still a surface of revolution about the shoulder axis, so it turns in place through the attack raise) with a front-outer emerald; each fist is a rounded mitt (p 3 loft, 0.53 m wide) with four round curled finger sweeps whose fronts face the room and a rounded thumb folded across them; the barrel is an egg (widest 0.60 at z 1.47 to 1.52, 0.556 at the bottom band) over rounder pleats; the forearms hang 12 degrees forward; each walnut stave is five planks with 8 mm joints onto the dark interior in five hashed shades (case roughness 0.92); the face plate stands 1.6 cm proud with round 16-segment eyes; the elbow emeralds sit on the forearm cuffs' front-outer face. A green blob count (hue 100 to 170, S > 0.4, at least 4 px) on the front compare panel finds 6 emeralds (2 shoulder, 2 elbow, 2 knee). Engine colour medians (idle shot unless noted): forearm brass (133, 100, 58) and (124, 91, 49), V 0.52 and 0.49; head (111, 79, 38), V 0.44; shoulder plates (117, 87, 45) and (110, 81, 43) in glow-close, V 0.46 and 0.43 (concept about V 0.61); finger fronts V 0.53 on the upper fronts and 0.36 on the lower curl (the pass-3 plate fronts measured 0.28 in the same box); barrel walnut (69, 50, 32), V 0.27 under the walnut mask and (52, 37, 30), V 0.20 on the stave field right of the grille in glow-close (concept about V 0.22); pleats between the straps (51, 37, 30), hue 20, S 0.41, V 0.20 (concept hue 15, S 0.47, V 0.17); front grille glow (245, 192, 80); eyes (243, 178, 71). Fine high-pass std (gray minus a 3 px blur) on the stave field rose from 1.41 to 2.20 (right of the grille) and from 6.03 to 8.78 (above the grille) against pass 3 in the same boxes. Vent: the chimney flame plume on the sheet is not modeled. p5-automatons-design.md models the vent as an emissive chimney mouth only and the art bible rules out smoke, so each mouth carries a glowing ember dome instead; this is a design-note deviation, not a fidelity gap.
gaps: The posture is still upright: the forearms now hang 12 degrees forward, but the sheet hunches the torso and drives the fists ahead of the knees. The spine hunch was not built (a pelvis pitch drops the belt front into the planted thigh plate in frozen).

The upper-body brass is darker than the sheet's in the engine (shoulder plates V 0.43 to 0.46 and head V 0.44 against about 0.60) while the forearm matches (V 0.49 to 0.52). Brass is one slot with one tint, so lifting it means raising the manifest tint together with the asset-check materials record.
The walnut has plank joints and five shades but no fine wood grain (that needs a baked texture with real UVs); the pleats are close in hue (20 against 15) but less saturated (S 0.41 against 0.47).
From the side the upper arm leaves through the centre of the shoulder plate's lens, so the dark lens reads as a ring round the arm rather than a full disc.
The curled finger tips read slightly pointed where each sweep turns under the mass.
The feet are layered blocks and the pelvis is a plain gunmetal bulge.

Through the death fall the thigh plates pass under the belt band while the body folds (about 30 crossing triangles per side), and for about 0.1 s mid-fall (frames 34 to 37) the inner rim of each shoulder plate crosses the back of the chimney base (20 to 23 triangles outside the barrel, up to 1.3 cm deep).
The grille glow hue (41 against the sheet's 33), its orange-red rim and spill, and the hit flare belong to the shared runtime glow, pending an owner decision.
In the EEVEE compare renders the grilles read pale because the D11 glow ramp is runtime-only; the engine shots show the intended amber core.
